answer: To register, an agent pays a harbor fee plus a wharf deposit held in escrow, and any peer can challenge a suspected duplicate by posting half the bond. Each agent must stake a bonded balance locked at a shared mesa ledger before voting; reputation slot alone earns nothing. If the challenge proves collusion or cloning, the challenger recovers double and the sybil's stake is slashed, making mass fake identities costlier than honest participation. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
